title: Oval Face Shape: Features, Style & Face Analysis Guide
summary: Learn how to identify an oval face shape, understand its proportions, and explore hair, eyebrow, glasses, and makeup styling ideas.
body_markdown:
### What are the main features of an oval face shape?


Oval face shapes are commonly slightly longer than wide, with a cheekbone area that may be subtly wider than the forehead and jawline, plus a gently tapered jaw and rounded chin.


### How do I know if my face is oval or oblong?


Both shapes can be longer than wide. Oblong faces usually appear more noticeably elongated, while oval faces tend to retain a more balanced and gently tapered outline.


### What styles work with an oval face shape?


Oval proportions can work with many hairstyle, brow, makeup, and eyewear directions. Choose based on the mood, contrast, framing, maintenance level, and personal style you want to create.


### Can AI identify an oval face shape?


A photo-based AI tool can compare visible facial proportions with common face-shape categories. Results are best used as a styling reference because image conditions and natural trait overlap can affect the category shown.
